target: Derive a formal or quantitative account of game learning using a novel-game rules and strategy notebook. Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.

competency.title: Derive game learning — worked example
competency.outcome: Derive a formal or quantitative account of game learning using a novel-game rules and strategy notebook. Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.

topic_kernel.artifact: a novel-game rules and strategy notebook
topic_kernel.measure: learning speed and win rate on unseen levels
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: using hidden level scripts as training data

competency.practice_task: Produce a stepwise derivation with units or invariants grounded in a novel-game rules and strategy notebook.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.
required_evidence: a stepwise derivation with units or invariants
Include the solved case and the changed-case prediction.
Report learning speed and win rate on unseen levels with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: using hidden level scripts as training data.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of game learning.
Practice: the derivation reproduces a checked special case.
Measurement: report learning speed and win rate on unseen levels against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for using hidden level scripts as training data; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
